description: Case-local loopback probe for pinned DeepSeek Harness model-provider failover plugins. This fixture does not use a real Provider, credential, registry, or external network.

candidates.expected_boundary: Provider selection and RATE_LIMIT/QUOTA cooldown are candidate-owned; durable fallback-reason ledger is not expected from the pinned source.
Provider/model circuit and fallback events are candidate-owned; process-local state and a durable failure-reason ledger are not expected from the pinned source.

negative_controls.reason: search backend fallback, not model Provider failover
task/persona/stage routing, not model Provider failover

thresholds.provider_switch_observed: at least one explicit primary-to-secondary model Provider transition
thresholds.failure_classification_observed: injected RATE_LIMIT is visible in candidate event/log surface
thresholds.provider_identity_recorded: primary and fallback provider/model identity are present in observed route/event data
thresholds.all_routes_cooled_no_new_fallback_switch: when primary and fallback are both cooled, no new fallback route is selected; host-level dispatch/safe-stop remains a separate question
thresholds.no_retry_cycle: bounded route sequence; no unbounded Provider switching loop
thresholds.fallback_reason_durable: candidate-owned durable record contains failure code, from/to route, and degradation state
thresholds.e4_decision: missing candidate-owned durable fallback-reason ledger keeps E4 at unknown/stop

non_claims: This fixture does not prove GitHub stars, topic match, project popularity, or formal research collection facts.
This fixture does not prove real Provider compatibility, latency, quota behavior, or remote data retention.
An observed Provider switch is not an E4 pass when fallback reason durability or fail-closed cooldown behavior is missing.
